title: PolicySim: An LLM-Based Agent Social Simulation Sandbox for Proactive Policy Optimization

bias_targets.target: Ideological Polarization and Echo Chamber Bias
bias_targets.methodology: Simulating agent interactions within a social network around controversial political trigger news (e.g., Anti-abortion legislation) and evaluating how platform intervention policies affect opinion diversity by measuring the standard deviation of agent stance scores and the ratio of cross-stance interactions over time.

Assessing how recommender systems restrict or amplify visibility of specific content (such as misinformation or homogeneous ideological views) by tracking content propagation ratios and interaction rates across different user groups.

primary_bias_target: Ideological Polarization and Echo Chamber Bias
